description_en: Disassociates a vSwitch from a multicast domain by calling the DisassociateTransitRouterMulticastDomain operation
description_zh: 调用DisassociateTransitRouterMulticastDomain接口解除交换机与组播域的关联关系
kebab_example: aliyun cbn disassociate-transit-router-multicast-domain --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --transit-router-multicast-domain-id tr-mcast-domain-91wpg6wbhchjeq0000 --transit-router-attachment-id tr-attach-g3kz2k3u76amsk0000 --dry-run false --vswitchids vsw-p0w9s2ig1jnwgrbzl0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DisassociateTransitRouterMulticastDomain

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the multicast domain
parameters.name: transit_router_multicast_domain_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the VPC connection.

This parameter specifies the ID of the VPC connection that was generated after the virtual private cloud (VPC) to which the vSwitch belongs was connected to the transit router instance
parameters.help_zh:
VPC连接ID。

本参数为交换机所属的专有网络VPC（Virtual Private Cloud）被连接至转发路由器实例后生成的VPC连接的ID
parameters.name: transit_router_attachment_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run without disassociating the vSwitch from the multicast domain. The system checks the required parameters, request format, and service limits. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): sends the request. After the request passes the check, the vSwitch is disassociated from the multicast domain
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会解除交换机和组播域的关联关系。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接解除交换机和组播域的关联关系
parameters.name: dry_run
